newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Resource Mortgage started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Resource Mortgage started.

text.p: -- Painewebber analyst Gary Gordon said he initiated Resource Mortgage Capital Inc with an attractive rating.
-- The analyst estimated that Resource Mortgage 1996 year earnings would amount to $3.03 per share, including a gain, and that the company would see $2.90 per share in earnings during the 1997 year.
-- He declined to say if he had set a target price on the stock.
-- He described the company as a "great short interest rate play."

-- "They are undervalued because they have had more volatile earnings in the past than some in their sector," Gordon said. "But they have restructured to create more stability, so that should help," he said.
